_source: MOIAT Draft Regulation UAE.S ....:2025 'Requirements for The Nutri-Mark on Front of Pack Labeling', 30 pp, WTO TBT ARE/679, PDF members.wto.org/crnattachments/2025/TBT/ARE/25_07209_00_x.pdf. Transcribed 2026-09-14 from rendered pages. Draft text, subject to change until approved.
_convention: Threshold arrays are 'greater than' steps: points = number of thresholds the value exceeds. Objects with explicit keys are transcribed as printed.

_verified_against_QCC_2026-09-14.authority: Abu Dhabi QCC is the scheme owner; the MOIAT draft cites QCC guideline ADG-044-2024 as its first reference. QCC official files downloaded to this folder: ADG-044-2024-En.pdf (guideline, 1st ed.), Nutri-Mark Guideline V2 Aug 2025 (brand/graphics manual), Q&A rev 2, Conditions for Use QCC-CoU01-01 (13 Apr 2026), calculation tool xlsx (Apr 2026). Source page: qcc.gov.ae/Nutri-Mark/Official-Documents-and-Tools
_verified_against_QCC_2026-09-14.calculator_general_foods: Matches this file: energy 335..3350; SFA <=1..<=10; FVL <=40/<=60/<=80/>80 -> 0/1/2/5; fibre scenario II (3.0,4.1,5.2,6.3,7.4); protein scenario II (2.4,4.8,7.2,9.6,12,14,17); salt 0.2-step to 4.0 (0-20); sugar scenario Ib (3.4,6.8,10,14,17,20,24,27,31,34,37,41,44,48,51); score = N<11 ? N-P : N-fibre-FVL; grade <1 A, <3 B, <11 C, <19 D, else E. kcal->kJ = ROUND(kcal*4.2); salt = sodium_mg/1000*2.5.
_verified_against_QCC_2026-09-14.calculator_cheese: score = N - P always (protein always counted); same tables as general.
_verified_against_QCC_2026-09-14.calculator_red_meat: protein points capped at 2 (<=2.4 -> 0, <=4.8 -> 1, else 2); otherwise general rule.
_verified_against_QCC_2026-09-14.calculator_fats: SFA ratio % of total fat <10..<64 -> 0..10; energy from SFA = SFA_g*37 with thresholds 120..1200; score = N<7 ? N-P : N-FVL-fibre; grade < -5 A, <3 B, <11 C, <19 D, else E.
calculator_defects_found: Cheese sheet: kcal->kJ conversion (col H) references the row ABOVE from row 3 onward (=ROUND(G2*4.2) in H3 ... 1,097 rows).
Red meat sheet: kcal->kJ conversion references the row BELOW from row 3 onward (=ROUND(G4*4.2) in H3 ... 1,098 rows per the independent audit).
Fats sheet: columns AE/AF ('score difference', 'change') contain #REF! and French leftovers from the Nutri-Score tool.

Beverages sheet (found by the independent audit): the water-flag route to grade A tests ISBLANK on the kJ and salt cells, which always hold formulas, so bottled water returns ERROR instead of the default A the Q&A grants. Reproduced in Excel and LibreOffice.
Beverages sheet (found by the independent audit): the salt chain uses M<3.2 among otherwise <= steps, so salt of exactly 3.2 g scores 16 instead of 15.
_verified_against_QCC_2026-09-14.independent_audit: research/CALC_REVIEW.md (Opus 5 agent, 14 Sep 2026): 16 test products computed three ways (own transcription of the cell formulas, LibreOffice recalculation of the official workbook, the prototype's JavaScript). Prototype defects found and fixed the same day: sugar table missing the 51 g step, salt table missing 3.0-4.0, FVL credit hard-coded to 0, protein not rounded to 2 dp.

official_palette_brand_manual_p4.font: ITC Handel Gothic Arabic (Bold EN, W23 Regular AR) - commercial, not on Google Fonts

_verified_against_QCC_2026-09-14.conditions_for_use_4.1: Public administrations/institutions of the UAE may use the mark for public actions in healthcare that do not compete with market use; software and application editors may use it to assist operators or inform the public. BOTH must request exceptional use by email to QCC prior to any use. Logo may only be reproduced from QCC-supplied files per the usage guidelines.
qa_rev2_points: based on the 2023 revision of Nutri-Score
no fundamental restrictions on use for products retailed in other Emirates or the GCC
not allowed to replace the mark with a QR code and show it only online
digital use: logo size not fixed, proportionality rules do not apply
explanations next to the mark must mention only score-calculation elements, not additives/preservatives
bottled/mineral/spring water gets a default A without a declaration; flavoured water cannot get A

basis: per 100 g (general, fats) or per 100 ml (beverages) — 5.3.1.2, 5.4.2.1, 5.5.2.1
energy_note: MOIAT draft p11 prints 1 kcal = 4.184 kJ; the OFFICIAL QCC calculator converts with ROUND(kcal*4.2,0) in every sheet. Use 4.2 to reproduce official grades; the difference can move an energy point at a boundary. Salt = Sodium x 2.5 (draft p11; calculator: sodium_mg/1000*2.5).

cheese_official_calculator.tables: identical to general (energy, SFA, sugar, salt, fibre, protein, FVL)
cheese_official_calculator.score_rule: score = N - P always (protein always counted)
cheese_official_calculator.grades: as general: <1 A, <3 B, <11 C, <19 D, else E

red_meat_official_calculator.score_rule: as general: N<11 -> N-P; N>=11 -> N-fibre-FVL

general._pages: Table 1 p10-11, Table 2 p11, rule 5.3.2 p11-12, Table 3 p12

P.protein_rounding: official sheet rounds protein to 2 dp before lookup: ROUND(protein,2)

general.red_meat_rule: If red meat/products >= 20% of the product (Annex 1, p21-22): protein points capped at 2.

fats_oils._pages: scope 5.4.1 p12-13, Table 4 p13-14, Table 5 p14, rule 5.4.3 p15, Table 6 p15
scope: vegetable and animal fats and oils, cream, ghee, butter
plant preparations used in cooking (soya, coconut...), whipped cream
nuts/oil seeds in composite foods with > 50% nuts or seeds (peanut butter, tahini)

energy_from_satfat_kJ._note: energy from saturated fat only: satfat_g x 37 kJ/g (p14, p20)

P._note: official column is 'Fruits, vegetables, legumes and oils derived from them' in g/100 g (numerically the same as %); oils from Annex 2 items (olive, avocado) count toward this component (5.4.2.1)

beverages._pages: scope 5.5.1 p15-16, Table 7 p16-17, Table 8 p17, rule 5.5.3 p17-18, Table 9 p18
scope: drinks with added sugar or sweeteners
tea and coffee prepared with water only
milk, drinking yoghurt, flavoured milk, chocolate milk, plant-based milk drinks (regardless of cocoa content)

scope_annex5._note: Mandatory categories once approved (1.1, Annex 5 p26-28). Clause 3.1: any other non-exempt product may carry the mark voluntarily.
02_fats_oils: fat emulsions, spreads, mayonnaise, oil-based sauces
06.3_breakfast_cereals: breakfast cereals incl. rolled oats, cereal bars, cereal-based snacks
07_bakery: fine bakery: cakes, biscuits, pastries, sweet rolls, muffins, mixes
14_beverages: fruit and vegetable juices and concentrates
water-based flavoured drinks, carbonated and not, concentrates

exemptions_2.1_p3: fresh whole/cut fruit and vegetables with nothing added
food served directly from preparation places (except bakery)
self-service packs with an accompanying label
infant foods 0-3 years, infant and follow-on formula, cereal-based baby foods
mark_placement_annex4_p25: recommended in the lower third of the front of pack; vertical, horizontal and simplified versions, five variants each; graphic name 'Nutri-Mark'

worked_example_inconsistency_p19_20.product: oat biscuits, per 100 g: energy 1850 kJ, satfat 6.0 g, sugars 18.0 g, salt 0.80 g, fibre 5.2 g, protein 7.0 g
worked_example_inconsistency_p19_20.note: Five of six per-nutrient points in the printed example disagree with the draft's own Tables 1 and 2; the final score (16) and grade (D) coincide.
